firstPlayerRule: Whoever most recently rescued a friend starts the first round. Turns proceed clockwise.
houseFallback: If this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: For the next round, the previous round’s winner starts. If several players tied for that win, choose randomly among those winners.
